definitions.contradictedInEvidenceOpenedBySession: discovery counterexamples inside a case or match page that the submitting session opened (access journal, HTTP 200)
definitions.contradictedInAccessibleEvidenceNotOpene: discovery counterexamples in pages that were served to every session but this session did not open
definitions.alreadyExemplifiedInDiscovery: held-out counterexample whose behavioural input values all occur in applicable discovery situations, where discovery already had counterexamples to the same clause
definitions.absentFromDiscovery: held-out counterexample with at least one behavioural input value (fields other than build, turn) that never occurs among the discovery situations to which the clause applies, same build
definitions.notCounterexampleInDiscoveryButValuesSee: held-out counterexample whose input values each occurred in discovery, while the clause had no discovery counterexample
